ruling: Operator-entered or field-observed data establishes OBSERVED geometry ONLY and can NEVER independently prove framing CAPACITY.

contractChange.old: isFramingVerified = operator-field completeness (framingType && rafterSize && rafterSpacing && rafterSpecies && rafterSpan). Live Braidon row (complete fields) was treated as VERIFIED and rendered modeled framing capacity.
contractChange.new: isFramingVerified = a verified FramingCapacityAuthority exists (verified+archived project-applicable document via lib/documents [truss_design_drawing / manufacturer_structural_calc / stamped_structural_analysis], OR a licensed-engineer review bound to the current snapshot digest). Operator completeness is OBSERVATION, never capacity authority.

authorityFlow.before: complete operator fields -> framingVerified=true -> framing check PASS + rendered utilization/adequate capacity (live).
authorityFlow.after: complete operator fields -> FramingObservation (source operator-entered, honest nulls) ; framingCapacityAuthority=null (no archived document / no digest-bound review) -> framingVerified=false -> FRAMING-AUTHORITY-UNVERIFIED fires, framing check passes:null, PRELIMINARY / NON-AUTHORITATIVE, no numeric capacity.

clearingPaths: Verified + archived, project-applicable document resolved THROUGH lib/documents (document class truss_design_drawing / manufacturer_structural_calc / stamped_structural_analysis; sha-256; current; verified; hasFramingCapacityClaim; exact project applicability).
Licensed-engineer review record bound to the CURRENT snapshot digest (invalidated by any digest change unless a new review covers the new digest).
invalidation: Framing approval (review path) references the snapshot digest. Any change to observations / geometry / module layout / racking / attachments / loads changes the snapshot digest by construction, invalidating prior approval unless the review covers the new digest — integrated with the snapshot_digest_invalidations ledger (lib/reconciliation).

provenance.note: OBSERVED framing geometry (source: operator-entered) — NOT capacity-verified. observer/timestamp absent on the source row (honest null). Operator-entered completeness is OBSERVATION, never capacity authority.
